question: Is the Aurzen TravelPlay a good back seat screen for a Tesla Model Y? Where can I buy one?
query: Aurzen TravelPlay review Tesla Model Y compatibility buy 2026

replays.text:
**It looks like a good fit if you have a 2025–2026 Model Y Refresh and want a projector screen for parked-car movie time.** TravelPlay is a foldable, clip-in screen and sunshade, with rear-seat, tailgate, and panoramic-roof viewing modes. It’s a screen—not a complete entertainment system—so you’ll need a separate compatible projector. Aurzen says to use it only while the car is parked. ([Aurzen product page](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y))

**Check your model year:** Aurzen says it’s designed for the 2025–2026 refresh. It may fit 2020–2024 Model Ys in roof-viewing mode, but the rear screen won’t fully cover the window.

You can buy it directly from [Aurzen’s U.S. store](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y), listed at **$119.99** in the search results. The listing says U.S.-only availability, with a 30-day money-back guarantee and one-year warranty.

**It can be a good back-seat screen if you want a projector setup—not a plug-in video monitor.** TravelPlay is a foldable, clip-in projection screen that also works as a sunshade. It has rear-seat, tailgate, and panoramic-roof viewing modes, but **you’ll need a separate compatible portable projector**. It’s for use only while the car is parked.

Fit is best on the **2025–2026 Model Y Refresh**. Aurzen says it can also fit the overall dimensions of 2020–2024 Model Ys in sky-roof mode, but the rear screen won’t fully cover the window.

Fit is best for the **2025–2026 Model Y Refresh**. Aurzen says it can fit **2020–2024 Model Ys** in sky-roof mode, but the rear panel won’t fully cover the window. Use it only while parked, and make sure the clips are fully secured.

You can [buy it directly from Aurzen](https://aurzen.com/collections/new-releases/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y). The listed price is **$119.99**; the listing says it’s available in the U.S. and includes a 30-day money-back guarantee and one-year warranty.
